title: Support MAPLE
subhead: MAPLE is free to use and built largely by volunteers. It's a project of Partners in Democracy – Education, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit.

donate.heading: Help keep MAPLE free for everyone
donate.intro: MAPLE is a free, impartial place to follow bills and tell the legislature what you think. That makes it hard to fund: it isn't flashy, and it doesn't fit neatly into advocacy budgets. It stays free when the people who use it chip in.

access.title: Free access for everyone.
access.body: The hosting, data and upkeep behind the site.

data.title: Information that's hard to find.
data.body: Hearing transcripts, lobbying data and conference committee deep dives.

next.title: What comes next.
next.body: New tools for the session that starts in January, like legislator profiles.

donate.finePrint: Secure payment through Partners in Democracy. Gifts are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law.
donate.fallback: Checkout not opening? <0>Donate on the Partners in Democracy site</0>.

useMAPLE.body: The best endorsement we can get is people using MAPLE and telling friends and colleagues about it.

volunteer.body: More than 100 volunteers have contributed to <0>MAPLE's code</0>. Developers, designers and researchers are all welcome.

feedback.body: Tell us what's working, what isn't, or what you'd like MAPLE to do next. If something's broken, use the same form and tell us which page you were on.
